Our offer

For developers

  • Embed professional translation services into your products and localization workflows.
  • APIs to orchestrate AI-first translation workflows, with human review defined by SLA.
  • API to build and integrate your own translation engine, powered by Lara AI.

For companies

  • Professional translations in 200+ languages.
  • AI-first workflows with human review defined by your SLA.
  • APIs and CMS connectors for seamless integration.
  • Lara Translate platform for employees’ everyday needs.

For translators

  • Work with us on your terms as a professional translator.
  • Free AI-powered tools for text, audio, subtitling, and dubbing.
  • Lara AI, inside professional CAT tools or as a standalone solution.
  • Training and long-term collaboration to support your growth.

Toward universal understanding

Introducing Lara 200 and Lara Think

During our latest event, we announced that Lara now supports 200 languages and introduced a new reasoning model, Lara Think. This milestone paves the way toward universal understanding, empowering enterprises and language professionals to deliver fluent, accurate translations to 80% of the world’s population by covering the official languages of the countries where they live.

Our clients

We proudly serve over 380,000 clients worldwide, including young, innovative startups and large global enterprises across a wide range of industries. We have optimized our processes to meet their unique needs, adapting from small, on-demand tasks to high-touch, fully managed solutions.

Why Translated

We envision a world where people from diverse cultures can communicate seamlessly, with unprecedented access to knowledge, cultural exchange, and business opportunities. Language is a key driver of human evolution, and we believe that solving the translation problem will unlock a new era of global collaboration.

Key benefits

Experience and trust

Since 1999, we’ve delivered 1.2 million translations in 236 languages to 380,000 clients across 40 macro-domains since 1999, powering the globalization strategies of the most demanding clients.

We work hard to make translation services more effective, by enhancing our production processes with great technologies and talented people. A perfect example is T-Rank™, a system that instantly matches your content with the most qualified translator for the job.

Latest news

Introducing TranslationOS, An Adaptive AI Service Delivery Platform

TranslationOS enables enterprises to run AI-driven localization with transparency, control, and confidence. It replaces legacy TM-centric workflows with a context-centric approach that works on full content context and coordinates AI with professional language expertise.

Read the news

St. Peter’s Basilica Delivers Holy Mass in 60 Languages Through Lara Interpreter

At the entrances and designated points within the Basilica, attendees will be able to scan a QR code to access a dedicated web page providing real-time audio and text translations of the liturgy. The initiative is part of the celebrations marking the Fourth Centenary of the Dedication of Saint Peter’s Basilica.

Read the news

Advancing Research in Language and AI with 5 New Imminent Grants

Translated has announced the winners of the fifth edition of the Imminent Research Grants, advancing independent research at the intersection of language and artificial intelligence. Discover the projects shaping how language technologies influence cognition, society, and global markets, and explore the ideas driving the next generation of AI.
